item.title: Ultimate Cron para dominar todas las tareas automáticas en Drupal
item.description:
Ultimate Cron to master all automated tasks in Drupal

In Drupal, managing automated tasks is crucial, but the built-in cron can be limiting. Ultimate Cron offers a flexible solution that allows you to customize the frequency and scheduling of each task, thus optimizing site performance and preventing server overload. In this article, I show how to start making the most of this module and use it efficiently and effectively.

item.title: Actualización selectiva de entidades durante migraciones de Drupal
item.description:
Selective entity update during Drupal migrations

When performing migrations in a system, it is sometimes necessary to update existing entities instead of creating new ones. However, this process can be complicated if only specific entities need to be modified. This article presents different approaches to facilitate the management of migrations according to the specific needs of each case.
